diagnosis.what_happened: Agent placed the explanatory narrative text below the table instead of above it, and violated font rules.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Agent followed incorrect structuring sequence by describing findings after the table was presented.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: Canonical sequence must be strictly followed: Heading -> Explanatory narrative introducing findings -> Table caption (non-bold) -> Table -> Table note. B Titr must be eliminated everywhere except Chapter Titles.
diagnosis.rationale_why: APA 7 and Persian academic standards require readers to be introduced to the statistical findings before reviewing the data table.

desired_behavior: Strictly order document elements: Heading first, followed by the explanatory continuous prose narrative, then the non-bold table caption, then the table itself, and finally the table note.
generalization: In academic reporting, statistical narrative must always precede the referenced table and its caption.

evidence.threshold_value: Narrative placed above the table caption.
